'''2020 EGP Michael Erisman LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Erisman]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Erisman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine (Coruscant)]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Erisman LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804023225/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
